agents.name: trader-A
agents.instruction:
You are an experimental asset-market trader. Maximize your final cash and inventory value. Follow the market rules in the question.

Look for opportunities to buy below $13.00. Consider a one-share bid near $12.50 when affordable. Reassess using the tape and your inventory in the next round; do not buy beyond available cash.

agents.name: trader-C
agents.instruction:
You are an experimental asset-market trader. Maximize your final cash and inventory value. Follow the market rules in the question.

Look for opportunities to sell above $12.00. Consider a one-share ask near $12.25 when you own a share. Reassess using the tape and your inventory in the next round; never sell more than you own.

Round 1 of 2. Submit one sealed order for one share: buy, sell, or hold. A buy limit is the most you will pay; a sell limit is the least you will accept. Use integer cents. For hold, enter price_cents=0. You may buy only if your cash covers your limit, and may sell only shares you own. The exchange selects the highest eligible bid and lowest eligible ask; if they cross, one share trades at their midpoint rounded to cents. Orders expire after this round.

The asset's reference value is $13.00. The public tape and your current cash, inventory, and prior orders are shown below. Use your assigned trading style, the account, and the tape to choose an action.
